notes.title: Start your engine!
notes.notes:
Hey YOU!

PizzaPanic is finally here, and we need a fearless bot operator like you to get these hot pizzas to our customers. It’s time to suit up! Take control of your new high-speed delivery bot and show the world what you’ve got. Tear through city streets, crash through obstacles, and unleash mayhem!

Assemble your crew for turbo-charged pizza-fueled destruction with all your friends!

Are you ready to cause PizzaPANIC? 🍕💥 Play now!

________________________

We are Catnip Lab, a small shady little studio crafting fun experiences for all. 
We are driven by passion. Encourage us and provide us with feedback so we can make the game better and get better at delivering exciting games for funky players like you.

notes.title: Get Ready to Play!
notes.notes:
Hey fellow Bot operators!

We are so happy to announce that PizzaPanic will finally release on December 1st 2024! And why not celebrate with a brand new fresh trailer showcasing some of the new content we added in the past few months. We're sorry we had to postpone the previous release date but it was so worth it. The game is now bigger than ever, and is fully playable online! Be prepared, playing against skilled foes will keep you at the edge of your seat! Bring your friends and have a blast with our new competitive game modes, Battle and Race. 

We are so proud of all the progress we made since Next Fest and we are very excited to see our first players roam around and fill our leaderboard.

See you in the streets !

Catnip-Lab

notes.title: WE GO ONLINE!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Bot operators!

We are very proud to announce that PizzaPanic will now feature online multiplayer. We think that you should be able to play with all your friends around the world from the comfort of your home. This is a huge game changer in our little world of pizza delivery and we hope you are as excited as we are to destroy your opponents on our online server. 

This new addition wasn't planned in our initial scope, which means we will need a little bit more time to make sure we implement it properly before launch. We are still aiming at a release before the end of the year so don't panic, you will be able to play with all your friends very soon!

Gather them and prepare for more frenzy to come!

>
Catnip Lab

notes.title: STEAM NEXT FEST - Update
notes.notes:
To all our hungry customers!

Join us during the Steam Next Fest and bring your friends to enjoy PizzaPanic, our latest multiplayer racing game. Play locally or with friends online using Steam Remote Play.  Our latest demo has ton of content and will only be available for a limited time. 

We are Catnip-Lab, a shady video game studio crafting weird experiences for all kind of players alike. Join the community and share your experience with PizzaPanic in our Steam hub. Your feedback will help us make the game better before the official release later this year.

notes.title: Play our Demo NOW!
notes.notes:
To all our hungry customers!

Catnip-Lab is proud to release a first Demo of a funky project we've been putting a lot of love into. Bring your family and friends and try our latest game for a crazy time guaranteed. We are a very small team of experimental artists trying to bring new experiences for players. Encourage us and spread the word about Catnip-Lab  and our unique games. <3

Get your engine runnin' and start racing across the city RIGHT NOW!

[i]Catnip-Lab Team.[/i]

notes.title: Join the Team!
notes.notes:
[b]To all our hungry clients.[/b]
Our bots are fueled up and ready to burst through the city. Discover the island in our new official trailer "Join the Team!". The sky is clear, the sun shines and the party is about to start. We have a ton of exciting news incoming and we hope you will join our team as the next best delivery bot operator.

[b]Learn about us[/b]
We are Catnip-Lab, a shady video game incubator crafting exciting new experiences for players. Catnip Lab is specialized in building unique IPs in a wide range of styles and genres. We create captivating narratives and engaging gameplay for all types of gamers and cat-lovers alike. From a fantastic adventure in a fantasy world to a drug deal in some dark alley, every moment from our games provides a new high for players. Catnip Lab currently has multiple projects under development and an epic line up of games releasing in the near future. Join us in the Catnip Lab universe, where each play brings you surprises, laughter, and a sprinkle of trippy magic. Follow our projects and find our games on steam so you don’t miss out on our future releases.

Follow our projects on http://www.catnip-lab.com
